_comment: Goal U10 registered the historical t8n cases Jaune refused; unit U11b resolved London and Paris, so hist-transfer-london and hist-transfer-merge (Paris) now conform against their goldens. The nine remaining forks are declared but unimplemented (Fork.rules? is none), so `jaune t8n` fails before reading any input with UnsupportedForkError, exactly as `lake exe jaune --rules <fork>` does. These cases are never marked passing: the gate requires the refusal, with this reason, and the goldens (generated from the pinned target) record the behavior later units will conform to.
